attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file PA Corporate Net Income Tax return. PA has $500,000 economic nexus threshold (higher than typical $100K).

condition_details.condition_comment: Has physical presence in PA (office, employees, property)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence get true eq apportionment.state_code get "PA" streq and
apportionment.has_economic_nexus get true eq apportionment.state_code get "PA" streq and

action_details.action_comment: Physical nexus established - PA CNIT filing required
action_details.action_description: PA filing required due to physical presence
action_details.action_postfix: "PA CNIT filing required due to physical presence. Reference: PA Code Title 72 7401(3)2.(a)(15)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Economic nexus established - PA CNIT filing required
action_details.action_description: PA filing required due to economic nexus ($500K threshold)
action_details.action_postfix: "PA CNIT filing required due to economic nexus. PA threshold: $500,000 (higher than typical $100K). Reference: PA Code Title 72 7401(3)2.(a)(15)(C)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no PA filing required
action_details.action_description: No PA nexus - no filing requirement
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No PA nexus - no filing required. Any estimated payments would be refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate PA state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to calculate PA adjustments
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus get true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence get true eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate PA state additions and subtractions
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef "PA income adjustments calculated. Additions: Federal interest, IRC 199A addback, state taxes. Subtractions: PA municipal interest, dividends (100% DRD), PA NOL. Reference: PA Code 7401(3)1.(b)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no PA state adjustments
action_details.action_description: No PA nexus - no adjustments calculated
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef "No PA nexus - no adjustments calculated." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate PA Corporate Net Income Tax (CNIT). Applies PA 8.99% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to owe PA tax
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus get true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence get true eq or

action_details.action_description: PA CNIT at 8.99% flat rate (one of highest state corporate rates)
action_details.action_postfix: apportionment.state_taxable_income get apportionment.state_tax_rate get mul /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_tax get apportionment.state_credits get sub 0.0 max /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get apportionment.state_tax get sub /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "PA CNIT calculated at 8.99% flat rate (one of highest state corporate rates). Reference: PA Code 7401(3)1.(a)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No PA nexus - no tax liability
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No PA nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_description: No PA taxable income - no tax
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No PA taxable income - no tax. PA NOL may be carried forward indefinitely (80% limitation). Reference: PA Code 7401(3)1.(b)(2)(B)(III)" job.audit_trail swap addto
